name: Monbazillac

blend: For sweet white wine, main grapes together: at least 80%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Monbazillac is a sweet white from Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc and Muscadelle.
It is broadly like Sauternes, but more Muscadelle in the blend can give slightly different aromas.
The grapes are always picked by hand in several passes through the vines.

blurb.text: A Bergerac appellation in South West France, across the Dordogne from the town of Bergerac, for sweet white wine made from Sémillon, Sauvignon and Muscadelle.
